probes.check: After the scheduler shuts down, the facade's probe-build block tracking shows enkiTS released no block the facade didn't allocate; one it did fails the rule as ALLOC_HOOK_LATE(enkits).

seeded_violation.description: Allocate a block with enkiTS's default allocator before installing the facade's, then free it through the facade's.

probes.check: am_probe_enkits_allocation(): the scheduler's configuration has the two enkits trampolines as its custom allocator, and the facade served enkiTS during the run.

seeded_violation.description: Remove the custom allocator assignments from am_bind_enkits_allocation().

adaptation_notes: enkiTS takes its allocator in enki::TaskSchedulerConfig::customAllocator, read once by TaskScheduler::Initialize: set it before the jobs phase, in the config setup glue owns.
enkiTS passes the alignment and size to alloc and the size to free; the facade's aligned functions need only the alignment.
